movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.synopsis: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movies.title: Barbara Forever
movies.synopsis: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

movies.title: By Any Means
movies.synopsis: A young Black FBI agent is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa, he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

movies.title: Dear You
movies.synopsis: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

movies.title: Filipiñana
movies.synopsis: Isabel feels strangely drawn to Dr. Palanca, the president of the country club where she works. However, after piecing together a violent picture of what lies beneath the club’s pristine surface, she realizes that what began as an innocent infatuation is actually rooted in a sinister shared history.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movies.title: The Sun Never Sets
movies.synopsis: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

movies.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
movies.synopsis: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

movies.title: Hope
movies.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movies.title: Black Zombie
movies.synopsis: A journey through cinema and history reveals how zombies evolved from Haitian spiritual traditions into Hollywood horror, exploring their deeper cultural significance as powerful symbols of resilience.

movies.title: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.synopsis: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.synopsis: The Owens sisters reunite to confront the dark curse threatening to unravel their family once and for all.

movies.title: The Fix
movies.synopsis: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.synopsis: During the English Peasants' Revolt in 1381, a farmer becomes a leader of the rebellion against the Crown forces of a then-14-year-old King Richard II.

movies.title: Daniel
movies.synopsis: Two pairs meet up at a restaurant, one for a date, the other for something more sinister.

movies.title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
movies.synopsis: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.synopsis: A medical courier making a routine delivery is caught in a sudden outbreak and forced into a desperate fight for survival.

movies.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movies.synopsis: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

movies.title: The Weight
movies.synopsis: In 1933 Oregon, Samuel Murphy is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal work camp. Warden Clancy tempts him with early release if he smuggles gold through deadly wilderness, but betrayal festers within the crew, and Murphy questions how far he’ll go to see his child again.

movies.title: Heaven in Stone and Glass
movies.synopsis: On April 15, 2019, the world watched in horror as flames erupted from the rafters of Notre-Dame Cathedral – an event that captivated global audiences and ignited an overwhelming response of loss, awe, and shared cultural grief. Why did the threat to this sacred space resonate so deeply, even among those with no religious affiliation? Bishop Robert Barron returns to France to answer this question, taking the viewer on a cinematic pilgrimage.

movies.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
movies.synopsis: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

movies.title: Charlie Harper
movies.synopsis: The journey of a young woman, Harper, and a young man, Charlie, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.synopsis: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

movies.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
movies.synopsis: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo's ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

movies.title: Never After Dark
movies.synopsis: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

movies.title: No Limbs, No Limits: The NickV Story
Primetime
movies.synopsis: A journalist investigates and exposes a criminal underworld, leading to a major shift in television.

movies.title: Victorian Psycho
movies.synopsis: In 1858, an eccentric young governess, Winifred Notty, arrives at the remote gothic manor Ensor House. As Winifred assimilates, staff begin to inexplicably disappear, and the owners wonder if something is amiss about this new gove...

movies.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution, Spread Love & Overalls, and Created a Community That Changed the World (in a Canadian Kind of Way)
Atonement
movies.synopsis: A troubled marine seeks to reconcile with the survivors of an Iraqi family he and his unit fired on back in 2003.

movies.title: Digger
movies.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

movies.title: Ghost in the Cell
movies.synopsis: A notorious prison, an invisible force starts killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

movies.title: The Scout
movies.synopsis: Sofia is a location scout for a TV show in New York City. Over the course of one day, she is invited into homes, businesses, and lives across the city, witnessing the private spaces and dramas of countless strangers, until her work takes a sudden, personal turn.

movies.title: Verity
movies.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

movies.title: André Leon Talley: Style Is Forever
movies.synopsis: André Leon Talley was a trailblazing fashion icon whose influence spanned nearly five decades. This documentary explores his legacy of inclusivity, elegance, and the fearless pursuit of authenticity. Interviews with Anna Wintour, Tom Ford and Diane von Furstenberg, among others, as well as never-before-seen footage, reveal Talley’s personal and professional challenges and remarkable triumphs.

movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
movies.synopsis: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

movies.title: Fjord
movies.synopsis: After the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave everything behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius' young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

movies.title: Misty Green
movies.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

movies.title: Other Mommy
movies.synopsis: A young girl, her family and their home are haunted by a sinister entity that is determined to take up residence inside her. But first, it needs to persuade her to let it in…

movies.title: The Social Reckoning
movies.synopsis: Facebook engineer Frances Haugen and Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz embark on a dangerous journey to expose the social network's most closely guarded secrets.

movies.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
movies.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

movies.title: Crawlers
movies.synopsis: When a man returns from a trip unwittingly harboring a new breed of arachnid, the people in an apartment block are quarantined and left to fend for themselves against a plague of venomous spiders.

movies.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
movies.synopsis: Follows Noah Silva, a used-car salesman whose unethical approach to business unravels at home and work. After wake-up calls, he begins a difficult journey to restore his integrity and win back his wife and son.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.synopsis: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

movies.title: Poetic License
movies.synopsis: Liz, a former therapist and soon-to-be empty nester, becomes the unexpected point of tension between two inseparable best friends and college seniors, Sam and Ari. Liz is forced to re-examine her life as the boys' friendship unravels in a fierce competition for her affection.

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.synopsis: Based on Jane Austen’s novel, sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood navigate love, uncertainty and societal pressures in the wake of their father’s death.

movies.title: Street Fighter
movies.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

movies.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
movies.synopsis: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

movies.title: Clayface
movies.synopsis: A promising Hollywood actor becomes a monster driven by revenge in a body-horror descent through lost identity, toxic love, and unchecked scientific ambition.

movies.title: Klara and the Sun
movies.synopsis: An Artificial Friend named Klara forms a profound bond with a girl whose complicated family is still healing from devastating loss.

movies.title: Wildwood
movies.synopsis: Two classmates enter a forbidden magical forest of enchanted creatures and dangerous enemies to rescue a kidnapped baby from a mysterious ruler.

movies.title: On the Road
movies.synopsis: Truck drivers worldwide lead an arduous life. Long and lonely hours behind the wheel, sleepless nights and the longing to return home after a journey that sometimes takes them across the country. North America is a large continent...

movies.title: Christmas at the Kringles
movies.synopsis: The Seversons, a family of three living in smalltown suburbia, whose next-door neighbors, the Kringles, have one minor quirk: They celebrate Christmas all year round. Mark and Julie Severson have mixed feelings about how much time their son, Bobby, spends at the Kringles’. But it’s not until he goes missing within the confines of the Kringles’ home that they realize their neighbors—and their religion—aren’t what they seemed. The couple will embark on a life-and-death journey to find their son that not only tests who they are, but who they want to become.

movies.title: Queen at Sea
movies.synopsis: As dementia erodes a woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interest, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection, and autonomy.

movies.title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA Live!
movies.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their newfound freedom in an unforgiving wilderness and under a new leader, Joshua. Captured in front of a live audience, JOSHUA LIVE! combines the energy of stage performance with the immersive experience of the cinema, bringing this unforgettable story of faith, courage and redemption to movie theaters.

movies.title: Wicker
movies.synopsis: An outcast commissions a husband woven from wicker, but their unexpected romance provokes jealousy throughout her rigid fishing village.

movies.title: Naughty
movies.synopsis: A bold romantic comedy about Shiva, a charming college student juggling three different relationships. As he tries to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humor, romance, and comedy.

movies.title: Club Kid
movies.synopsis: A hard-partying New York club promoter's whirlwind lifestyle is upended by the arrival of the ten-year-old son he never knew he had.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movies.synopsis: Direct continuation of Takashi Yamazaki's Godzilla Minus One.

movies.title: Jimmy
movies.synopsis: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

movies.title: Wild Horse Nine
movies.synopsis: On the eve of Chile's 1973 coup, two CIA agents sent to Easter Island become entangled with rebellious students, old secrets, and present-day conspiracies.

movies.title: Ebenezer
movies.synopsis: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

movies.title: Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol
movies.synopsis: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

movies.title: How to Rob a Bank
movies.synopsis: A social-media-savvy robbery crew broadcasts its heists, unaware that viral fame has put a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer on its trail.

movies.title: Paper Tiger
movies.synopsis: Two brothers enter a deal too good to be true and become trapped in the dangerous orbit of the Russian mafia as their family bond begins to fracture.

movies.title: I Play Rocky
movies.synopsis: The true story of an unknown Sylvester Stallone betting everything on the conviction that he must both write Rocky and play its leading role.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movies.synopsis: Panem returns 24 years before The Hunger Games, on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Games—the brutal Second Quarter Quell.

movies.title: Elsinore
movies.synopsis: A powerful, deeply moving and inspiring story of the actor Ian Charleson who faced incredible odds while preparing to give the performance of his life in Hamlet at the National Theatre in London.

movies.title: Focker-in-Law
movies.synopsis: Greg and Pam Focker's son Henry sets off a fresh round of family chaos when he announces plans to marry a woman who seems to be his complete opposite.

movies.title: Hexed
movies.synopsis: An impulsive teenager discovers hidden magical abilities and is swept into the witch realm of Hexe, where she and her cautious mother uncover world-changing family secrets.

movies.title: Behemoth!
movies.synopsis: A gifted cellist returns to Los Angeles after twenty years on the road, where music carries him toward an adventure that will transform his life.

movies.title: Violent Night 2
movies.synopsis: Santa returns for another blood-soaked holiday adventure in the sequel to the 2022 action comedy.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.synopsis: Heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course as they confront an existential threat unlike anything they have faced before.

movies.title: Dune: Part Three
movies.synopsis: As emperor, Paul Atreides grapples with political conspiracies and a galaxy-spanning holy war whose consequences threaten the future only he can foresee.

movies.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
movies.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet: surviving fatherhood while once again saving the world.

movies.title: Jumanji: Open World
movies.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

movies.title: Mr. Irrelevant
movies.synopsis: The heartfelt story of the inspiring, enduring impact John Tuggle had on his team and teammates after being drafted by the New York Giants.

movies.title: Mr. Irrelevant: The John Tuggle Story
movies.synopsis: The true story of John Tuggle, who was given the title after being the last pick of the last round of the 1983 NFL draft.

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movies.title: Pendulum
movies.synopsis: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifyin...

movies.title: Children of Blood and Bone
movies.synopsis: Zelie and her older brother Tzain form an alliance with the king’s daughter, Princess Amari, and son, Prince Inan, to fight back against his brutal rule.

movies.title: The Beekeeper 2
movies.synopsis: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

movies.title: Air Bud Returns
movies.synopsis: A grieving 12-year-old boy finds his dad's old VHS tape and befriends a stray golden retriever in his new town. Together, they chase basketball dreams, rally a team of underdogs, and discover what it means to play with heart.

movies.title: Drag
movies.synopsis: A routine robbery at a rural house turns into a nightmare for two amateur burglars when one of them throws their back out. Things spiral out of control as they try to make it out before the homeowner returns.

movies.title: The Rescue
movies.synopsis: A rodeo cowboy and his dog search for his missing daughter.

movies.title: The Comeback King
movies.synopsis: A country western star experiences a dramatic downfall and must navigate their career in free fall.

movies.title: Cliffhanger
movies.synopsis: During a weekend trip with a billionaire's son, seasoned mountaineer Ray Cooper and his daughter Sydney are targeted by a gang of kidnappers. Ray’s other daughter Naomi, still haunted by a past climbing accident, witnesses the attack and escapes. To save her family, she must confront her fears and fight for survival.

movies.title: K-Pop: The Debut
movies.synopsis: A young Korean-American woman defies her family's wishes to compete in a televised competition to find the next K-pop girl group.

movies.title: Live Like That
movies.synopsis: Based on the powerful true story, a young man's legacy becomes the light that unites a fractured community after decades of conflict.
